text:
Hey do a investigation on the framework code, i want to know what the current gap is to do this: inside of cart/editor in the studio: make a tv -> select a face -> declare it as a screen -> export as prop -> place the prop -> render some react on it, real time, without affecting the gameplay loop. 

is that even possible? give me your expert opinions
resolution: Investigated the active cart/editor Studio and framework end to end without changing code. Confirmed the keyed StaticSurface-to-Scene3D GPU path already supports same-frame live screen sampling, while current native face selection, RJMD v2/model manifests, prop cook/placement records, and world-loader bindings do not preserve a semantic screen slot. Also traced V8 timers, host-tree rebuilds, and wall-clock gameplay stepping, establishing that strict zero-impact 60 Hz React screens are not possible today. Prepared a Zig-native surface-slot, channel registry, dirty/budgeted scheduling, and ship-path recommendation.
